source.editionId: Саша Чёрный, Детский остров (1921), Жеребёнок; Wikisource revision 4735748

rights.original: Sasha Chorny (died 1932); the poem was published in 1921. Public domain in Russia and in life-plus-70 jurisdictions since 2003, and in the United States as a work published before 1931.
rights.transcription: Russian transcription from Wikisource contributors, CC BY-SA; source page links to its revision history and terms.
rights.translation: New English translation for Slovarchik, CC BY-SA 4.0; no published translation reused.

sentences.ru:
Хвост косичкой,
Ножки — спички,
Оттопырил вниз губу…
Весь пушистый, золотистый,
С белой звездочкой на лбу.
sentences.en:
Tail like a little plait,
Legs like matchsticks,
His lower lip stuck out…
All downy, all golden,
With a white star on his forehead.

sentences.ru:
Юбку, палку,
Клок мочалки —
Что ни видит, все сосет.
Ходит сзади тети Нади,
Жучку дразнит у ворот.
sentences.en:
A skirt, a stick,
A wisp of bast —
Whatever he sees, he sucks at it.
He walks behind auntie Nadya,
And teases the dog at the gate.

sentences.ru:
Выйдет в поле —
Вот раздолье!
Долго смотрит вдаль и вдруг
Взвизгнет свинкой,
Вскинет спинкой
И галопом к маме в луг.
sentences.en:
He comes out into the field —
What freedom!
He gazes into the distance a long while, and suddenly
Squeals like a piglet,
Kicks up his back
And gallops off to his mother in the meadow.
